{{Quote|Blast! This is why I hate flying!|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="aotc" />}}
The '''Dogfight over Geonosis''' was a short confrontation between [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] inside the dangerous [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-filled ring around the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-controlled planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. It took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Background==
{{Quote|Dad! I think we're being tracked!''"<br />"''He must have put a homing device on our hull. Hang on, son. We'll move into the asteroid field, and we'll have a couple of surprises for him.|Boba and Jango Fett noticing a Jedi starfighter approaching|<ref name="aotc" />}}
After a [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)/Legends|duel]] with [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] threw a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing device]] on the departing [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I's'']] hull. He tracked the ship to the planet Geonosis. After [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] saw they were being tracked, Jango flew the ''Slave I'' into the ring around the planet.

==The Skirmish==
[[File:SeismicCharge.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A seismic charge detonating.]]
{{Quote|Get him, Dad! Fire!|Boba Fett to his "father"|<ref name="aotc" />}}
Obi-Wan Kenobi followed in close pursuit of Jango, dodging asteroids and incoming [[Seismic charge/Legends|seismic charges]]. Jango flew through tunnels in asteroids, but Kenobi would not give up. Getting the drop on Obi-Wan, Jango was now in pursuit and fired blasters until Obi-Wan's [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] was hit. Jango then fired a homing missile, intending to finish it off.
{{Quote|R4, prepare to jettison the spare part canisters. Fire them now!|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to R4-P17|<ref name="aotc" />}}
Finally, Kenobi told his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[R4-P17/Legends|R4-P17]] to release the interceptor's spare parts. The missile could not dodge the number of tiny objects and exploded, leading Jango to believe he had destroyed his enemy. Kenobi landed on an asteroid and powered down until Jango had entered Geonosis's atmosphere. He then followed the ''Slave I'', ultimately leading to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Mission on Geonosis]].
